mapping.summary: Dealer management system for agricultural, construction and heavy equipment dealers: sales, parts, service.
claims: Supports differential taxation and used-parts tax
Document prints follow DIN 5008 type B and can be sent by e-post
Automatic charges and discounts such as freight
Machine attributes on items and service items with filtering
Wizard to rebook between current assets and fixed assets
Links purchase and sales for replenishment orders
Shopping cart to import and export vendor files
Imports supplier catalogs and price lists, with surcharge rates per catalog
Handles substitute and interchangeable parts
Warehouse picking and put-away documents are processed automatically
Tracks each machine through its life cycle with a trade number
Machine sales configured and priced through a CPQ module with calculation worksheets
Imports manufacturer configurations, depending on the manufacturer
Handles trade-ins from customers and vendors
Commission based on revenue and contribution margin
Service intervals are tracked with notifications
Warranty and warranty claim handling
Checklists on service orders, service order splitting and fixed-price invoicing
Maintenance contracts are managed
Requires Premium edition
